tools.name: check_defects
tools.description: Before using an MCP server or an API operation, ask what is known to be wrong with it. Takes one identity: an MCP registry entry (io.github.owner/repo), a deployment URL, an OpenAPI document URL, or a host. Answers one of three things, and they are three rather than two: `defects_known` - open recor

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "check_defects" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Before using an MCP server or an API operation, ask what is known to be wrong with it. Takes one identity: an MCP registry entry (io.github.owner/repo), a deplo…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
